title.en: Gold v2 delayed companion track reconciliation
title.zh: Gold v2 延迟伴随轨道协调

purpose.en: Complete the generic Gold v2 audio-room companion fix by keeping bounded provider discovery and delayed-track reconciliation active for valid background meeting tabs during four-participant production acceptance.
purpose.zh: 在四人生产验收中让有效后台会议标签页继续执行有界服务商发现及延迟轨道协调，完成 Gold v2 音频房间伴随连接的通用修复。

en: Reconcile subscribed participant maps every 750 ms while shared media is active so a delayed live track renders even when the SDK mutates it without an event.
Keep bounded companion discovery and delayed-track reconciliation active in background meeting tabs so four-tab participants receive remote camera, file, web, and whiteboard media.
Discover all joined companion peers, subscribe their late video tracks, and reconcile participant and video update events so remote camera, file, web, and whiteboard content renders reliably.
Route each subscribed-course dashboard link through the classes page's supported target query parameter.
Publish bilingual Project evidence for English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian real-learning coverage.
zh: 共享媒体激活期间每 750 毫秒协调一次已订阅参与者映射，使 SDK 未触发事件而延迟写入的实时轨道仍可渲染。
让后台会议标签页继续执行有界伴随参与者发现及延迟轨道协调，使四标签页参与者可收到远端摄像头、文件、网页及白板媒体。
发现全部已加入的伴随参与者、订阅其延迟视频轨道，并协调参与者及视频更新事件，使远端摄像头、文件、网页和白板内容可靠显示。
让 Dashboard 的每个已订阅课程链接使用课程页支持的 target 查询参数。
发布英语、日语、西班牙语及意大利语真实学习覆盖的双语 Project 证据。

en: Remove the visibility short-circuit from the bounded companion discovery and low-frequency local-map reconciliation paths without adding continuous provider paging.
SmartLingo audio Group Call and Webinar remote companion media rendering and its regression contract.
Learner Dashboard course navigation and its target-language selection contract.
Administrator Project release history only; no payment, referral, certificate, or entitlement schema is changed.
zh: 移除有界伴随参与者发现及低频本地映射协调路径中的可见性短路，同时不新增持续服务商分页。
SmartLingo 音频 Group Call 与 Webinar 的远端伴随媒体渲染及其回归契约。
学员 Dashboard 课程导航及其目标语言选择契约。
仅更新管理员 Project 发布历史；付款、推荐、证书及课程权益架构均不变。

en: Replace local-map-only companion rendering with bounded provider discovery, event reconciliation, one-time subscriptions, and freshest-map track selection.
Add a directly testable subscribed-course URL builder and replace the unsupported language query key with target.
Add a behavioral regression proving the selected target survives URL parsing and the obsolete key is absent.
zh: 以有界服务商发现、事件协调、一次性订阅及最新映射轨道选择替换仅依赖本地映射的伴随媒体渲染。
新增可直接测试的已订阅课程 URL 构造函数，并把不受支持的 language 查询键替换为 target。
新增行为回归测试，证明 URL 解析后目标语言仍然存在，且旧查询键不再出现。

en: America/Los_Angeles date 2026-09-01; anonymous GitHub preflight run 33495295098 passed all 32 route checks for day 12.
Sentence-catalog contracts passed 21/21, covering 36 courses with 120 sentences each and unique ten-item daily rounds.

The dedicated test learner completed real production course vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and dialogue in English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian; each language persisted five measured learning minutes.
Five-minute Sprints completed at EN 80, JA 80, ES 80, and IT 60; score history and each language's Today’s Sprint Top 25 category were verified.
SmartCard Practice answer-feedback-continue completed in all four languages; each legitimate correct answer created +10 course credit.
SmartCard Challenge answer-feedback-auto-advance completed in all four languages, including the six-second transition; no completion score was fabricated.
One beginner airport Everyday Speaking scene completed in all four languages with normal and slow playback controls; repeat-after-me remained off and no microphone permission was requested.
AI labels, adult-only Nearby opt-in copy, broad location copy, block/report controls, and four-language AI partner turn-taking pages were verified without enabling location or sending messages.
Legitimate Sprint rewards were EN +25, JA +25, ES +25, and IT +12; normal challenge, ranking, learning-minute, and course-credit records were expected QA output.

No payment, referral, certificate, checkout, or entitlement action was invoked. Remote D1 ledger read-back was unavailable locally because no Cloudflare API token was present, so no database-level unchanged claim is synthesized.
The production error reproduced only for /zh/classes?mine=1&language=en; the control route without the unsupported parameter logged no error.
zh: America/Los_Angeles 日期为 2026-09-01；匿名 GitHub 预检运行 33495295098 通过第 12 天全部 32 项路由检查。
句子目录契约 21/21 通过，覆盖 36 门课程、每门 120 句及每日 10 个不重复题目。
专用测试学员在英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语生产课程中完成词汇、阅读、写作、听力及对话；每种语言均持久化 5 个实测学习分钟。
四语 5 分钟 Sprint 均完成：英语 80、日语 80、西班牙语 80、意大利语 60；已核对成绩历史及各语言 Today’s Sprint Top 25 分类。
四语 SmartCard Practice 均完成答题、反馈、继续流程；每次有效正确答案正常产生 +10 课程积分。
四语 SmartCard Challenge 均完成答题、反馈及 6 秒自动前进；未虚构完成分数。
四语均完成一个初级机场生活口语场景，并核对正常与慢速播放；跟读始终关闭，未请求麦克风权限。
已核对 AI 标识、Nearby 仅限成人主动选择说明、宽泛位置说明、屏蔽／举报控件及四语 AI 伙伴轮流对话页面；未开启定位，也未发送消息。
Sprint 正常奖励为英语 +25、日语 +25、西班牙语 +25、意大利语 +12；挑战、排名、学习分钟及课程积分记录均为预期 QA 输出。
未触发付款、推荐、证书、结账或权益操作。因本地没有 Cloudflare API 令牌，远程 D1 账本无法只读回查，因此不合成数据库级‘未变化’结论。
生产错误仅在 /zh/classes?mine=1&language=en 复现；不含不支持参数的对照路由没有控制台错误。

en: Physical-device microphone recognition and repeat-after-me remain outside this no-microphone acceptance.
Remote database-level payment, referral, and certificate ledger read-back requires deployment credentials and remains explicitly unverified by the local QA session.
zh: 真实设备麦克风识别与跟读不在本次无麦克风验收范围内。
付款、推荐及证书账本的远程数据库级回查需要部署凭据，本地 QA 会话明确未对此作验证。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's Chinese interface, twelve-language routing, official course catalog, learning records, score history, AI safety labels, and education disclaimers.
Limit the implementation to the SmartLingo learner-dashboard link contract; shared site architecture is unchanged.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 中文界面、十二语言路由、正式课程目录、学习记录、成绩历史、AI 安全标识及教育免责声明。
实现仅限 SmartLingo 学员 Dashboard 链接契约；共享站点架构不变。

rollback.en: No data migration is included; restore the preceding Worker release to roll back the navigation change.
rollback.zh: 本次不含数据迁移；如需回退导航变化，恢复上一版 Worker 即可。
